protocol.selection: Up to three distinct non-overlapping reference windows per group. One per recording first, then additional windows where available; ordered by recording ID and distance to the median available anchor. No outcome-based selection.
protocol.scope: Frozen controller-reference libraries, not all overlapping windows assigned during decomposition.
protocol.rendering: Same robot model, camera distance 1.45 m, azimuth 135 degrees, elevation -18 degrees; native 1280x720, 30 fps, no captions burned into reference clips.
